cards.text: Solomon, son of David, is now Israel's king. Later, he makes a BIG move: an alliance with Pharaoh king of Egypt, by marrying his daughter. He brings her to the City of David until he finishes his palace, the house of the LORD and the wall around Jerusalem.
But here's the catch. The people are still sacrificing on the high places.

cards.question: Why are the people still sacrificing on the high places?

answers.text: No house for the LORD's Name was built yet
The king ordered them to go there

cards.text: Now, Solomon himself. He walks in the statutes of his father David.

cards.question: True or false: Solomon loved the LORD.
Solomon walked in his father David's statutes, except that he sacrificed and burned incense on the ___.

cards.text: Now the king goes to Gibeon, the great high place, and offers a THOUSAND burnt offerings on the altar there. Friend, I stamped forty cookies in a row once and had to go lie down on my gold base.
Then one night at Gibeon, the LORD appears to Solomon in a dream.

cards.question: In the dream at Gibeon, what does God say to Solomon?

answers.text: Ask and I will give it to you
Go and tear down the high places
Rise and lead My people out

cards.text: Before Solomon asks for anything, he looks back at his father David. He says God showed David much loving devotion.

cards.question: Why does Solomon say God showed his father David so much loving devotion?

answers.text: David asked Him for great riches

cards.text: And God kept that devotion going by giving David a son to sit on his throne this very day. That son is Solomon, made king in his father's place.

cards.question: Now Solomon tells God how he sees himself as king. He says he's only a little ___.

cards.text: Solomon says he doesn't know how to go out or come in. That's day one as the BOSS, holding the keys to the whole building, and you can't even find the light switch.

cards.question: Solomon looks at the people God has chosen. True or false: he says they're too many to count.
God said ask. So what does Solomon ask God to give him?

answers.text: A heart to judge with understanding
Wealth to build a great kingdom

cards.question: Solomon wants to judge God's people and discern between good and evil. True or false: he says he needs help because the people refuse to obey him.

cards.text: Now it pleased the Lord that Solomon asked for an understanding heart. Me? I'd have asked for an oven that never burns a batch, and called it a prayer request.
So God answers him, starting with what Solomon DIDN'T ask for: long life, wealth for himself or death for his enemies. Instead, Solomon asked for discernment to administer justice.

cards.question: Solomon's request pleased the Lord. True or false: God tells Solomon He will do what he asked.
God says He'll give Solomon a ___ and discerning heart.
God doesn't stop at a wise heart. True or false: He tells Solomon that someday there will be another like him.
God keeps going. What does He say He'll give Solomon that Solomon didn't request?

cards.text: Riches AND honor, and God says no man in any kingdom will be his equal all his days. That's like asking for one cookie and walking out with the bakery, the ovens AND the delivery cart.

cards.question: God adds one more promise, with an if. If Solomon walks in God's ways like David did, God says He will ___ Solomon's days.

cards.text: Then Solomon wakes up, and sure enough, it had been a dream. The best dream I ever had was a cookie box that packed itself, and I woke up hugging my own mustache.
So he returns to Jerusalem and stands before the ark of the covenant of the Lord. He offers burnt offerings and peace offerings there.

cards.question: After his offerings before the ark, what does Solomon do for all his servants?

answers.text: He holds a feast for them
He gives each one a gift
He frees every one of them
